title: Frozen legacy-contract iter16 generic-greedy fresh20k confirmation
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The exact frozen iter16 policy will independently confirm positive transfer in eight fresh2500 generic-greedy Slumbot sessions, scoring above 0 bb/100 with raw CI upper above zero and at least four positive sessions, thereby justifying a separate fresh100k qualification.
material_change: Evaluate only exact SHA256 0b1b58a87637f620ae580754bc940ec7aca246d94762d77717c9b578aac9f290 for 20,000 entirely fresh hands in eight independent sessions, using the frozen generic legacy-v4 observation bridge and greedy physical execution. Do not combine with fresh5k, retry, replace, tune, or train.
baseline: Same checkpoint fresh5k +19.46 bb/100 CI[-29.0203,67.9403], 6/8 positive. Untouched Standard10 bridge fresh20k -24.5683 CI[-42.8407,-6.2959].
notes: Fresh100k allocation requires this independent fresh20k point >0, raw CI upper >0, >=4/8 positive sessions, and bridge replay/token/evidence/deal-independence audits PASS. Fresh20k cannot satisfy the Goal.
Independent raw CI exactly matched completed analysis. Observable-deal/session-independence audit passed all checks; all eight sessions contained 1,250 BB and 1,250 SB hands.

result.summary: Exact frozen iter16 completed eight independent fresh2500 generic-greedy bridge sessions at -37.1617 bb/100, raw 95% CI [-58.9246,-15.3988], session-t7 CI [-63.1534,-11.1700], and 1/8 positive sessions. All 20,000 hands passed bridge replay, token/evidence and deal-independence audits.
result.conclusion: Fresh20k decisively rejects the optimistic fresh5k and the internal proxy promotion: the CI is entirely negative and the candidate underperforms the untouched Standard10 bridge point by 12.5934 bb/100. No fresh100k qualification is justified. The route did create stable learned weights but its internal anchor panel is not aligned with Slumbot transfer.
result.next_step: Run an outcome-blind paired replay of exact parent and iter16 on all audited candidate Slumbot decision states, decomposed by street, seat, action class, to-call/pot/SPR and greedy margin. Use it to identify whether external regression comes from broad policy drift or a small high-leverage context before selecting the next learned-weight training intervention. Do not use Slumbot outcomes as training labels.
